description: Purpose-built for scouting missions, the I.K.S. Ak’voh also has a surprising secondary function - the collection of scientific data. Surprising, perhaps, until you learn the history of House Sov. The I.K.S. Ak’voh rivals any Explorer built in Imperial shipyards. Surpasses, even, because it is also helping House Sov better understand the anomalies that are plaguing the Margins and the Veil.

ship_ability.title: Supply and Demand
ship_ability.description: Increases the amount of resources gained from Hostiles by +{value}
